lessons.key: surviving_mutant::prove a ci log grep against a real log from the current toolchain e g xcode 26 logs retries as started iteration 2 of 2 never against strings copied from an older pipeline
lessons.text: Prove a CI log-grep against a real log from the current toolchain (e.g. Xcode 26+ logs retries as 'started (Iteration 2 of 2)'), never against strings copied from an older pipeline.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::guard scripts must fail on missing inputs and distinguish grep exit 1 no match from exit 2 error and be tested on the ci s own os gnu vs bsd
lessons.text: Guard scripts must fail on missing inputs and distinguish grep exit 1 (no match) from exit 2 (error), and be tested on the CI's own OS (GNU vs BSD).

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::when a spec says warnings as errors in ci name the job that enforces it and pass the treat warnings as errors flags there explicitly
lessons.text: When a spec says 'warnings as errors in CI', name the job that enforces it and pass the treat-warnings-as-errors flags there explicitly.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::an architectural invariant e g extension never depends on app code needs a ci check that fails on the forbidden edge build success and inspection do not detect it
lessons.text: An architectural invariant (e.g. 'extension never depends on app code') needs a CI check that fails on the forbidden edge; build success and inspection do not detect it.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::when guarding a packaging invariant also assert file globs patterns source files resources not only dependency edges
lessons.text: When guarding a packaging invariant, also assert file globs/patterns (source_files, resources), not only dependency edges.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::guard a manifest with an allowlist of permitted keys shapes not a denylist of known bad fields platform scoped attributes and nested specs bypass field by field checks
lessons.text: Guard a manifest with an allowlist of permitted keys/shapes, not a denylist of known-bad fields; platform-scoped attributes and nested specs bypass field-by-field checks.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::every declared manifest value an ac names platform tools version needs its own assertion builds passing does not prove a minimum version constraint
lessons.text: Every declared manifest value an AC names (platform, tools version) needs its own assertion; builds passing does not prove a minimum-version constraint.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::persistence identifiers used only by production wiring e g the userdefaults suite name of a shared singleton need their own golden assertion per test isolated stores never exercise them
lessons.text: Persistence identifiers used only by production wiring (e.g. the UserDefaults suite name of a shared singleton) need their own golden assertion; per-test isolated stores never exercise them.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::a no pii in logs sentinel test must drive every log site that has a pii value in scope including failure paths e g registration failure not one representative flow
lessons.text: A no-PII-in-logs sentinel test must drive every log site that has a PII value in scope, including failure paths (e.g. registration failure), not one representative flow.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::assert a global s effective initial value read without setting it not only the default constant that tests copy into it before asserting
lessons.text: Assert a global's effective initial value (read without setting it), not only the default constant that tests copy into it before asserting.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::give every conjunct of a multi condition guard e g both ids non empty its own negative test one empty id case covers only one of them
lessons.text: Give every conjunct of a multi-condition guard (e.g. both ids non-empty) its own negative test; one 'empty id' case covers only one of them.
